name: Podcast Insights
description: Import podcasts and transcripts, verify original quotes, and compare views with evidence. Optional user-confirmed paid cloud transcription.
whenToUse: Podcast transcripts, summaries, content questions, cross-show viewpoints, original quotes, speakers and timestamps. Searches imported material only.

tools.name: podcast_import
tools.description: Import public RSS, Apple Podcasts, Xiaoyuzhou or audio links. Store up to 500 episode metadata; fetch selected publisher transcripts (latest 3 default). Xiaoyuzhou RSS candidates require a real user card click; never automatically choose.

tools.name: podcast_import_transcript
tools.description: Save user-provided JSON, VTT, SRT, TXT, MD or supported HTML transcript, at most 5 MB. Preserve versions; never invent missing timestamps or speaker identities.

tools.name: podcast_library
tools.description: List shows, episodes, cloud jobs and library space; supports transcript-state filters and pagination.

tools.name: podcast_search
tools.description: Search normalized Chinese/English keywords in imported text. Optional show/episode/time filters; at most 50 hits with adjacent context. No semantic or automatic cross-language search.

tools.name: podcast_read
tools.description: Read transcript pages, around a segment or from a timestamp. At most 20000 characters per call; follow next_offset. Tool results may be sent to the current model service.

tools.name: podcast_cite
tools.description: Check original quotes, including adjacent segments. Return exact, normalized or not_found. Only verified quotes enter cards. Verifies wording, not AI interpretation; call before quoting in answers.

tools.name: podcast_transcribe
tools.description: Prepare an AssemblyAI estimate only; tool arguments cannot submit. A real confirmation card click sends the public audio URL for full-audio processing and incurs provider charges. User-supplied key required.

tools.name: podcast_status
tools.description: Check and resume cloud jobs without resubmitting. Unknown submissions need provider reconciliation; no automatic retry. Stopping local polling does not cancel cloud work or charges.

secrets.label: AssemblyAI API Key
secrets.hint: Optional. Cloud processing and provider charges require a confirmation card click.

items.name: workflow
items.description: Import, verified citations, cloud estimates, user confirmation and recovery.
